_comment: Public texts of the task page and the scorecard (site/build.py). `title` and `subtitle` replace task.json's title; `references` (each proof of par's design, leaderboard/par.json) and `baselines` (each baseline with a banned operator) describe each design in one sentence (the internal notes of task.json and tests/expected.json are never shown). `walk_through` (the tutorial): the reference pair the walk-through copies, a proof of par's design (site/build.py `walk_reference`).
title: Bitwise AND
subtitle: A toy task that runs the whole pipeline: y = a & b on N bits.

references.band: One AND gate per bit: `assign y = a & b;`.
references.band_tactics: The same design, byte for byte, proved with the `sv_comb` tactics (`sv_structure`, `sv_interface`, `sv_equations`) in a quarter of the code lines: the proof the walk-through starts from.
